hard_skills.note: Strong match on SQL, Python, APIs, and Power BI dashboards.

jd.text:
Purpose

Drive digital transformation by building data solutions, automating processes, and delivering insights, beside leading the data digital tools She/He will be responsible for enhancing the existed data accuracy and build the right procedures for the new data streaming in the way that improve business performance.

Ideal Candidate

Someone who can combine: Business Understanding + Data Engineering + Analytics + Automation + AI

Key Responsibilities

• Design and support digital transformation Initiative in her/his area of responsibilities.

• Build and maintain data pipelines and integrations.

• Connect data from ERP, CRM, eCommerce, APIs, and other systems.

• Develop datasets, dashboards, and KPIs using Power BI or through the existed reporting platforms.

• Improve data quality, governance, and accessibility.

• Identify automation opportunities and implement solutions.

• Support AI expansion initiatives.

• Collaborate with the different teams to translate requirements into solutions. Collaborate with Regional and Global teams to reflect and localize the data and digital transformation strategy.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, Data Science, or related field.

• 2-4 years of experience in Data Engineering, Analytics, Digital Transformation or Systems Integration.

• Strong SQL and database knowledge.

• Knowledge with Python and APIs.

• Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools.

• Knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).

• Strong problem-solving and communication skills. English is a must
